name: Burnish
description: Burnished back to light: arcs opening out of one corner of every cell.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; circle*5 { cx: 0; cy: 100; r: calc(@n(-1) * 22 + 14); fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 9 }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; circle*5 { cx: 0; cy: 100; r: calc(@n(-1) * 22 + 14); fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 9 }); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
